title: Plugin Playground
ready: Run the full demo to prepare fixtures and see every capability result.
scope.title: Official testing and development example
scope.text: The full demo prepares separate fixture files without per-operation selection or confirmation. Individual editor probes modify the active note; marked probes still require consent. File writes, moves and deletion require the target to be closed in every editor.
input: Text (edit, search query, storage value or notice)
consent: I understand and allow the selected mutation or external request
confirm: Delete the current fixture: enter DELETE
form.hint: Edit the form to observe debounced callbacks. Hidden and disabled fields are omitted from submission.
events.hint: Events stay in memory. Refresh to see new events without render loops. Success means this invocation completed, not full system certification.
permissions.hint: All permissions are optional. Missing grants produce PermissionDenied. Grant the relevant capability in plugin permissions and retry.
cleanup.hint: The attachment API has no delete method. Remove generated attachments and older fixtures manually in the file manager. Restarting or changing workspaces does not adopt older fixtures.
name: Name (at least two characters)
dialog.hint: Try conditional fields, validation feedback, update, replacement and close. Update and replace do not save the form.
readOnlyOperation: Query or UI demonstration; does not write notes
error.folder: Set a non-empty, valid workspace-relative test folder.
error.workspace: Workspace changed. Run again in the new workspace.
error.fixture: Create a fixture note first. Restarting or switching workspaces requires a new fixture.
error.editor: Open a Markdown editor and finish IME composition first.
error.existing: Target already exists; this plugin will not adopt it. Create another fixture.
error.page: No next page, or folder/workspace changed. List notes again first.
error.delete: Enter DELETE to confirm deletion of the current fixture.
error.changed: Revision or content changed after the stale write was rejected.
error.source: This operation requires Markdown source mode.
error.input: Text must be a string of no more than 2000 characters.
error.name: Name must contain at least two characters.
op.calendar: Calendar: time zone and logical day
op.note-read: Read selected file or current fixture
op.note-search: Search saved notes in fixture folder
op.editor-read: Read editor, selection and Markdown snapshot
command.throw: Playground: throw intentional error (error handling test)

demo.title: Experience the complete demo
demo.description: Run all 32 capability examples and open both sidebars, a tab and an interactive dialog. This creates, edits and deletes fixture files in the test folder, uses plugin sample storage, and visits notegen.top. Editor demos only modify this session’s fixture notes. Missing grants or unsupported capabilities are reported individually.
demo.complete: Demo finished. Close the dialog to inspect results in a sidebar. Switch to source mode and use individual probes for source-only editor operations.
error.demoEditor: The demo note is not active yet, or another note is active. This editor demo was not executed; retry from a sidebar.
